findings.title: Multi-proof-path last-writer-wins guard aggregation
findings.body: _scan_artifacts overwrites guards.self_certification_status (and similarly live_write_status, merge_seam_status) per proof file in the loop with no aggregation across multiple proof_paths. If an incomplete proof is listed before a complete one, the incomplete file's UNKNOWN is silently overwritten by the later complete file's NONE, and the whole scan reaches PASS. Empirically confirmed pre-existing on the parent commit (worse: parent also passed for the complete-then-empty order, which the audited commit correctly blocks). Not in scope for F001/F002 (both concern single-proof identity classification); fixing it requires aggregation logic beyond the allowlisted files' minimal-change mandate. Recommend follow-up finding DMX-W1-04-F003 to make guard aggregation a monotone worst-of across all supplied proof paths rather than last-write-wins.

findings.title: Pre-existing UNKNOWN-to-PRESERVED/NONE normalization outside this diff
findings.body: red_lane_scanner.py:245-271 (not modified in the audited commit) converts merge_seam_status, dopetask_execution_status, external_write_status, github_mutation_status from UNKNOWN to PRESERVED/NONE purely on the absence of specific finding categories. This block is outside the two named findings and outside the allowlisted diff, so it is not treated as a defect of the audited commit, but the fail-closed invariant should be read as confirmed only for the guard the audited commit actually touches (self_certification_status), not the whole GuardsInfo surface.

fixes_applied: DMX-W1-04-F001: RedLaneScanner no longer reaches PASS/NONE self-certification on empty, malformed, or identity-incomplete proof evidence; missing implementer or auditor identity now yields UNKNOWN rather than a false NONE. Verified via live repro against both the audited commit and its parent, and via test_dcp_0005_red_lane_scanner.py (8 new tests, including a real subprocess CLI exit-code test).

DMX-W1-04-F002: control_snapshot no longer reaches READY when a prerequisite packet has zero evidence (UNKNOWN state) or only a proof file with no task-packet (CLAIMED state); both are now blocking. Verified via a live constructed fixture and test_dcp_0004_control_snapshot.py (1 new test plus new fixture tests/dcp/fixtures/tp_dcp_0004_missing_tp0002_evidence/).
